Marissa / Laura / Monica — tagging you for quick help.

Summary of options (fastest to slowest):
1) Manual token top-up: Ops can credit individual accounts (one-off) with the agreed 10k-token package. Fast, but requires write access to the billing ledger (ops request).
2) Unique promo codes: Generate 1:1 promo codes (promo-codes.csv) that grant the trial + extension. Ops sends codes to attendees; lower risk to billing ledger.
3) Email fix + extension only: If a bounce caused the issue, resend onboarding + 14-day extension and flag for analytics.

Marissa — can you run a quick audit to confirm whether those three emails were processed at the time of issuance or if they bounced? If it's just bounces, option 2 (promo codes) + resend looks safest. If not, I'm OK approving manual top-ups for up to 5 attendees for this event.

Please reply with which route you recommend and an ETA to complete before tomorrow's onboarding. I'll loop Susan when we have a plan.

—Vivek
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick audit complete. Findings below: 
- Bulk issuance job ran at 2025-10-06T02:11UTC and 247/250 early-bird rows were matched to existing accounts and credited.
- Two of the three flagged rows show delivery bounces on welcome@redwoodinference.com (typos in registration email) — those records show "delivery_status: failed" in the job log (audit-snippet.txt attached).
- The third row was credited to a duplicate account (different email) so the registrant didn't get the personalized onboarding email but does have trial tokens applied to another account.

Recommended remediation (fastest safe path):
- Generate 3 unique promo codes (10k tokens + 14-day extension) and send directly to the three registrants. This avoids ledger edits and preserves the batch reporting.
- For the duplicate-account case, patch the mapping so analytics reflect the correct user and resend onboarding.
- I'll prepare the promo-codes.csv and a short resend template for Ops to use.

ETA: I can have promo-codes.csv ready in 45 minutes and Ops can send in the hour. If you prefer manual top-ups instead, note that will require finance sign-off and may delay sending until EOD.

—Marissa
